tasks.title: Task 34a — the age-resolved headship curve (exposure-abscissa monotone cumulative Hermite)
tasks.instructions:
### Task 34a: the age-resolved headship curve (operator ruling V)

**THE DESIGN IS SETTLED AND COMMITTED. READ IT FIRST AND DO NOT RE-OPEN IT:**
`docs/research/2026-08-19-headship-curve-design-panel.md` — a five-agent design panel (constraint map
→ three independent designs → a judge that RE-DERIVED each from its own text). Its §5 is a build
specification; §6 is its stated uncertainties. **This mandate does not retype that document. Build
what it specifies.** Where this mandate adds a seat ruling, it says so.

#### Why this exists

Operator ruling V, 2026-08-19. The pre-PR quant gate measured `D_native` at **68-100% band-step
artifact**, ~2.5x the entire ranked signal at MTL_RMR, from materialising a SIX-band headship curve at
single years of age — the reuse `census.py` forbids in its own words. The operator chose to build the
curve properly rather than ship the rankings with a caveat.

#### The three facts that shape the build, all measured on committed bytes

1. **The granularity is already committed.** `census_tenure_age_98100231.csv` publishes 15 members:
   `Total -` plus 14 age members. **They are NOT all five-year.** Twelve are (15-19 … 70-74);
   **`75 to 84 years` is TEN-year and `85 years and over` is open-ended** — the granularity degrades
   exactly where the supply side lives. This is why Sprague/Beers/Karup-King-Newton were NAMED AND
   REFUSED by all three designers: those multipliers require uniform panels.
2. **The denominator is already single-year** — 101 columns, ages 0..100, from `pop-as-qc-base.xlsx`.
3. **The committed curve asserts 8,304 phantom households maintained by someone aged 0-14**, and
   understates 15-19 by **4.17x**.

#### The decision

**Build P1's chassis — exposure-abscissa monotone cumulative Hermite — with the terminal rule PINNED
as §5.1 item 4 specifies, grafting P2's and P3's gate discipline.** It won on the criterion that
matters most here: **its member closure is ALGEBRAIC, not numerical.** The member endpoints ARE
interpolation knots, so the sum telescopes exactly — independent of tangent rule, refactor, seed, or
whether any iteration converged. Measured 0.0 on all 14 members under both arms and across 200
perturbed re-extracts. The alternatives conserve at ~1e-11 because their solves converged.

#### Seat rulings layered on top of the design document

- **The naive 14-member STEP curve is REFUTED and must not be built** — it is the WORST option
  measured (horizon-mean D_native +54.6%, 44-50% of it at the single age 25). Consuming the
  granularity without a shape rule makes the artifact worse. The success metric is CONCENTRATION:
  largest single-age share of D_native must land in the **14-18%** band (committed is 65-77% at age
  35).
- **COMPUTE YOUR OWN REFUTATION FIGURES, never transcribe the design document's.** The judge could
  NOT reproduce one of P1's quoted numbers (`h(100) = 2.059`) and says so; it is
  evaluation-convention dependent. Every diagnostic the artifact records must be computed by the
  generator on this vintage.
- **Use the shape-invariance identity as your cheapest closure check:** base-year OwnerStock under ANY
  member-closed curve is `2,245,600 − 1,150 − 17,170 = 2,227,280` exactly (vs 2,179,183.37 committed,
  +2.207%). If your curve does not produce it, your closure is wrong. Verify this EARLY.
- **The under-15 zero is a POSITIVE BOUND, not an absence claim.** Write it as "closure pins under-15
  maintainers below rounding scale, so 0.0 is the only admissible value" — **never** "the table is
  silent", **never** "proved exactly zero". The dimension declares cardinality `(15)`, and closure
  bounds any unpublished member at X ≤ 35 households against 1,364,340 persons.
- **YOU ARE ADDING A SWEEP AXIS TO A SWEEP THAT IS ALREADY THE SUITE'S DOMINANT COST, and you own
  the bill.** The design's §5.4 wires `headship_shape` into `SWEEP_GRID`, and the run-33 fold that just
  landed took `_rank_stability` from two legs to TEN — the demoflow suite went **168s to 270s (+61%),
  measured by the seat**. Your axis makes it twelve. Run 33's mandate asked for a session-scoped
  fixture or a configurable leg count with the full set as the committed default; **neither landed, and
  the golden tests still call `run_pipeline` directly.** Land one of them now. A gate slow enough that
  people stop running it is a gate that has stopped working, and this cost compounds with every future
  test that touches the pipeline. **The committed golden must still be minted from the FULL sweep** —
  a reduced sweep in the committed artifact is the exact defect run 33 existed to close.
- **The 74/75 osculatory overshoot is the winner's one real curve defect** (peak 0.66202 at age 77,
  +2.2% over the member-rate hull, touching only OwnerStock). **Record it and PIN IT BY TEST. Do not
  paper it over, and do not "fix" it with an unanchored clamp** — the design measured that a hull
  clamp produces `h(15) = −0.0061`.

#### What must NOT move in this commit — the ordering is physically enforced

`census._AGE_BAND_SPEC` / `_AGE_BANDS`; `formation.OWNERSHIP_LATTICE_FLOOR = 25`; `pipeline`'s
`range(25, 101)`; `_ownership_spec_omitted_members` and its raise; `living_arrangement.json` and the
75+ cohort machinery; `demand/immigrant_inputs.py`; the tripwires. Spec §7 amendment #12 binds the
order, and note the design's observation: **extending the ownership floor downward in the same commit
takes out the headship generator with a `LoaderError`** — the constraint is enforced by the code, not
only by doctrine. If you hit that error, you have violated the ordering.

#### Expected outcomes — these are the point, not regressions

- **The ranked ORDER is expected to MOVE**, including a rank-1 sign flip and a 7/8 swap. Report the
  before/after table from a live run.
- **`assumptions_hash` moves** (a `headship_shape` central choice enters the selection) **and the
  artifact digest moves**, so both documents re-mint. Declare it; do not let the re-mint hide an
  unrelated move.
- `tests/test_golden.py` will be RED until the re-mint. Leave it red and report it.
- **Blast radius is large and deliberate:** ~119 headship references in `test_census_ownership.py`, 49
  in `test_i2.py`, 41 in `test_demand.py`, 31 in `test_owner_stock.py`. These are contracts to rewrite
  deliberately, not breakage to route around. Stale prose at `owner_stock.py:65` and
  `formation.py:58` still says "banded".

**IF A DESIGN-DOCUMENT CLAIM FAILS ON THE LIVE TREE, STOP AND REPORT.** The judge's ranking
magnitudes are explicitly probe-grade (raw ISQ in place of P_resident, ~7% scale) — directions
robust, levels not — and it flagged the ranks 2-4 permutation as unresolvable at its fidelity. A
divergence there is expected and is NOT a failure; a divergence in CLOSURE is.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING — the seat commits at run close after its own diff review. RED-first binds. Run-unique scratchpad subdir; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for mutation batteries; probe on COPIES and never disable a guard in the live tree. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail, figures derived from that run and never transcribed.

tasks.instructions:
### Task 34b: re-mint the golden and discharge the notes the curve retires

Runs after task 1. Do not start it early.

1. **Re-mint both documents ONCE** through the committed generation path (`scripts/gen_golden.py`),
   never a hand-run. BOTH identity tokens move — `assumptions_hash` (the new `headship_shape` central
   choice) and `data_vintage` (the headship artifact's digest) — so a reader must expect two moved
   fields. Note the known reporting quirk: `test_golden.py`'s `_match_golden` short-circuits on the
   FIRST cause, so its message will name only one.

2. **Update `demoflow/artifacts/README.md`'s reading table** to record that the ranking ORDER moved,
   why, and that this re-mint is the ordered consequence of ruling V.

3. **Discharge `census._zero_support_note`'s age-resolved warning EXPLICITLY.** That note says a
   consumer multiplying a single age inside a band "must land an age-resolved curve rather than reuse
   this one". Rewrite it — **never delete it** — keeping its three claims distinct: the under-15
   bound (as a positive bound, per task 1), the age-resolved warning marked DISCHARGED and naming
   what retires it, and **the sub-25 ownership clause, which STILL STANDS.**

4. **Record what run 15 got wrong about conditions.** Its record wrote "it reopens when Task 29 lands
   an age-resolved headship curve"; Task 29 landed WITHOUT one and nothing reopened. **A condition
   whose trigger nobody checks is not a condition.** Whatever reopening language you write for the
   sub-25 ownership question must be phrased so its trigger is CHECKABLE — name the artifact field or
   test that would fire, not an event someone is supposed to notice.

5. **Do NOT re-measure spec §7 amendment #12's QFE legs here.** The design lists that as a separate
   ordered follow-on and it is the seat's to schedule.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING — the seat commits at run close after its own diff review. RED-first binds. Run-unique scratchpad subdir; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for mutation batteries; probe on COPIES and never disable a guard in the live tree. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail, figures derived from that run and never transcribed.
